description: Takes a list of purchase requisitions (id, date, requester, description, quantity, amount, cost centre, supplier) and groups the ones that describe the same need within a time window (default 30 days): word overlap of the description of at least 50 percent plus a similar amount (within 10 percent), or at least 80 percent word overlap. Identical text, amount and quantity are red, near-identical yellow. Returns the groups, the amount that would be bought twice, and whether the duplicates come from one requester (entered twice) or several (same need from two places). For duplicate invoices use compare_invoices. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: One row per requisition: id, date, requester, description, quantity, amount, cost_center, supplier. German column names work too (nummer, datum, anforderer, beschreibung, menge, betrag, kostenstelle, lieferant).

window_days.description: Optional: only requisitions this many days apart are compared. Default 30.

name: find_duplicate_requisitions
title: Duplicate requisitions: identical and near-identical purchase requisitions in a list, with the amount at risk
